limitations: Finite stock UFO/TFTD tactical TU inventory scope; no prebattle, non-TU, broad mod, full-fairness, model or token result.
Complete battle/runtime and simulation RNG checks do not use libc RNG as an oracle.
Only naturally advanced settled whole-image phases are compared; first-rendered, post-view and collection-entry snapshots remain separate.
Immediate live warning observations are distinct from later returned-I warning visibility.
The depth-0 sound lookup is observed; the subsequent play() call is source-only. Muted dummy audio establishes no audibility or mixer-output result.
Source and dependency equality is checked at recorded checkpoints, not by continuous monitoring or a hermetic runtime closure.
SDK visible outcomes require separate manual attestations; receipts and PNG hashes never prove native success, refusal, TU cost or liveness.
SDK terminal seals establish finalization-checkpoint integrity only; they do not establish before/after runtime immutability or independently observe process exit.
Fault detections, survivors and inconclusive outcomes remain distinct. Phase acceptance does not mean every fault was detected.
R2 lineage ancillary files are transitively freeze-bound and rechecked at assembly; this does not add them to earlier main-plan runtime audits.
Initial pre-freeze bytecode caches are explicitly excluded. No post-freeze exclusion changes are permitted.
Four inherited Windows project files differ between Git blobs and CRLF checkout bytes; no whole-tree Git byte identity is claimed.
Three legacy RIGHT helper anchor repairs are pure maintenance only; no previous native mutants are rerun.

Palette evidence covers the explicit unsupported-presentation precondition (SUPPORT9000) together with normal reset invalidation; STALE116 remains the refusal/no-dispatch endpoint. It does not isolate one palette guard or establish arbitrary-palette stale guarantees.
Earlier preparation and harness-integration corrections remain setup-only lineage, not repeated native attempts.
